tests: At viewport 1168px with 308px sidebar (~330px inspector), manual image input and alt input shrink without exceeding the inspector boundary or overflowing into the preview column.
Long URLs and unspaced strings in manual image inputs, AI context card, and AI before/proposal boxes wrap within container bounds without horizontal overflow or text clipping.
Manual action buttons and AI proposal action buttons wrap onto multiple lines when card width is constrained, keeping all buttons clickable and visible.
AI launch button wraps long action labels ('Enregistrez le brouillon avant de lancer') cleanly without forcing parent grid expansion.
When version history panel is open (showHistory === true) and a draft is successfully saved, getVisualPageHistory is queried for the exact saved page ID.

When the refreshed history arrives, the new saved revision is verified against pageRef.current.id and pageRef.current.revision before updating historyList, immediately showing the new revision labeled 'Version actuelle'.
If document or revision changes while the background history fetch is in-flight, late history results are safely ignored without corrupting current state.
If getVisualPageHistory fails or rejects during save, the save success notice ('Brouillon enregistré sur le VPS. La page publiée reste inchangée.') remains intact and no save failure error is raised.
